primer: Uber Technologies (NYSE: UBER) runs an asset-light global marketplace for rides and delivery, reaching $193.5B in FY2025 Gross Bookings and $59.82B in Q3 2026. Trailing Free Cash Flow stands at $10.4B on 0.6% capex intensity, backed by >50M Uber One members and a >$2.5B Advertising run-rate. At $68.81 (13.48x P/FCF), the stock prices in autonomous vehicle fears while sitting in a Stage 4 downtrend below its 50D ($69.31) and 200D ($72.55) SMAs. We rate the business COMPOUNDER_PASS (PASS_WITH_WATCH) and assign WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT ($62.00–$65.00 entry zone, $58.50 stop, $88.00 Base target, 3.54:1 R:R).
